_meta.source: July 2026 masterplan (jeffrey mak: architect ltd) and the Aug 25, 2026 plan stats workbook, via the Apple Blossom Commons research project
_meta.note: All figures are planning concepts. 'publicFacts' and 'places' may be shown on the site; 'internalNotes' must never be rendered. Keys match data/district-geometry-v1.json. 'places' are named places and ideas from the July 2026 masterplan, shown under 'What's planned here' (docs/11-plan-and-districts-content.md). A text ending in '(concept)' is shown with that word muted.

districts.name: Chelan Wine Village
districts.summary: The heart of the community: a small village of tasting rooms, cafés, restaurants and shops, laid out for people on foot along Vintner's Walk.
publicFacts: The Barrel House, Tasting Courtyard, Market Hall

places.name: Harvest Square
places.text: The main plaza at the center of the village, where the trails and neighborhoods meet. A place for markets, music and seasonal events.

places.name: Vintner's Walk
places.text: A lane for walking, not driving, lined with coffee shops and small stores along the village's central spine.

places.name: The Tasting Courtyard
places.text: A courtyard of small tasting rooms for local wineries, so you can try wines from around the valley in one place without driving between them.

places.name: Market Hall
places.text: An indoor-outdoor market for local food, crafts and wine, with small kitchens run by local cooks next to the tasting rooms.

places.name: The Barrel House
places.text: A shared winemaking hall for local wineries, with production space, barrel storage, tastings and a restaurant.

places.name: Neighborhood shops
places.text: Smaller corner shops are planned near each neighborhood, so everyday errands stay close to home.

districts.internalNotes: Includes the top block near Discovery Commons, the main village and the diagonal Retail High Street spine.

districts.name: Wellness District
districts.summary: Medical uses next to the hospital campus, with clinics, therapy and rehabilitation close to the senior homes.
publicFacts: Clinics, physical therapy and rehabilitation (planning concept)

places.name: Clinics and therapy
places.text: Clinics, physical therapists and rehabilitation services planned close to the senior homes, within reach on foot or by car. (concept)

places.name: Medical assisted living
places.text: Assisted living with medical support, planned beside the hospital campus. (concept)

places.name: A short walk to the hospital campus
places.text: The district sits next to the existing hospital campus, so care is planned to be close by.

districts.internalNotes: Presented as part of Apple Blossom Commons. The hospital belongs to Lake Chelan Health; do not call them a partner until they agree to be named. Oct 28, 2026: hospital and Columbia Valley Community Health removed from publicFacts (neighbor-only rule); 'Lot 17' is the parcel for medical assisted living; rehabilitation confirmed by the masterplan Wellness sheet.

districts.name: Orchard Grove
districts.summary: Cottage homes, townhomes and apartments for active adults, designed for people who want to stay in their homes as their needs change.
publicFacts: Recreation center with gardens, tennis courts, a walking track and an event hall

places.name: Cottage homes
places.text: Single-family cottages for individuals and couples, with privacy of their own and community amenities nearby. Designed with accessibility in mind for aging in place.

places.name: Senior townhomes
places.text: A range of townhomes, giving neighbors more than one kind of home to choose from. (concept)

places.name: The Recreation Center
places.text: Gardens, tennis courts, a walking track and a hall for community events.

places.name: Everyday life, taken care of
places.text: Ideas being explored include home and grounds maintenance, shared meals made with local food, group hikes and outings, and pet-friendly homes. (concept)

districts.internalNotes: Oct 28, 2026: masterplan Life Plan bullets on fees and priority care access left out (promises). 'Affordable senior housing' shown as 'senior townhomes' until its meaning is confirmed. 55+ wording conflicts with the FAQ; see docs/09.

districts.name: Heritage Grove
districts.summary: Homes for seniors who prefer or need support, from independent living to assisted living, memory care and nursing care, planned around garden courtyards.

places.name: Independent living
places.text: For people who manage on their own but like the ease of a senior community.

places.name: Assisted living
places.text: Help with daily routines for people who no longer want to live alone.

places.name: Memory care
places.text: Homes designed for people living with Alzheimer's or dementia.

places.name: Nursing care
places.text: Around-the-clock care for people who need it.

places.name: Garden courtyards
places.text: Each group of homes is planned around a protected courtyard for short walks and time in the sun, with paths to the rest of the community.

places.name: Shared clubhouses
places.text: One clubhouse for independent and assisted living, with a club room, fitness room, movie room, library, quiet room and guest suites. A second for memory and nursing care, with guest suites, a library, a salon, dining and nursing staff on hand around the clock. (concept)

districts.internalNotes: ~419 units or beds is unresolved (units vs beds). Do not publish a count.

districts.name: Apple Blossom Residence
districts.summary: Market-rate apartments, townhomes and detached homes for families and households of every kind, with green buffers along Chelan Falls Road and Apple Blossom Drive.
publicFacts: Green buffers along the main roads

places.name: Townhomes and apartments
places.text: Larger family-sized townhomes and apartments.

places.name: Detached homes
places.text: Single-family homes with private backyards, for people who want a bit more room and privacy.

places.name: Green buffers
places.text: Planted edges along Chelan Falls Road and Apple Blossom Drive, so homes face green rather than traffic.

districts.internalNotes: Not senior housing. A 75,000 sf building on the PDF is missing from the workbook; totals range 126–332 units. Do not publish a total.

districts.name: Harvest Crossing
districts.summary: Homes for people who work in Chelan, close to the village's shops and services, with a live-work zone.

places.name: Apartments near the village
places.text: Studio and one-bedroom apartments a short walk from the village's shops and services.

places.name: Live-work zone
places.text: Homes with space to run a small business on the ground floor. (concept)

districts.internalNotes: 200 apartments approved by the owner for public use on Oct 16, 2026; revise if it changes. Oct 28, 2026: masterplan calls these an 'affordable option'; not used publicly (no pricing claims).

districts.name: Summit Recreation Park
districts.summary: Sports fields, a seasonal rink, a playground and a pond, in two parts north and south, joined by trails.
publicFacts: Seasonal rink: roller in summer, ice in winter (planning concept)
Children's play area and a small pond

places.name: Seasonal rink
places.text: A rink that could be used for roller skating in the warm months and ice skating in winter. (concept)

places.name: Sports fields
places.text: The existing soccer and baseball fields, plus another field for pickup games.

places.name: Children's discovery park
places.text: Nature-inspired play for kids, next to an interactive water feature.

places.name: The pond
places.text: A small pond planned to add habitat and a quiet place to sit.

places.name: Vineyard hiking trail
places.text: Trails with native planting that tie the park to the village and the neighborhoods.

districts.internalNotes: Two separate parts; the geometry has two label positions.

districts.name: Discovery Commons
districts.summary: An aspiration for lifelong learning: a potential K-12 school, community center and library.

places.name: A place to learn
places.text: Land set aside for a potential school in the future.

places.name: Community center
places.text: Space for gatherings, events and indoor recreation for all ages.

places.name: Library
places.text: A library near the learning and recreation areas, for readers young and old.

districts.name: Orchard Preserve
districts.summary: Open space with trails and a scenic overlook at the highest point of the site.

places.name: Scenic overlook
places.text: A trail to the highest point of the site, with a view out over the town.

places.name: Open hillside
places.text: Much of the land is planned to stay open, keeping its natural character.

places.name: Bike and walking trails
places.text: Trails that link the neighborhoods, the parks and the village.

places.name: RV park and campground
places.text: A small area for visiting RVs and campers. (concept)

districts.name: Grand Orchard Hotel
districts.summary: A cottage-style hotel with event space at the edge of the village.

places.name: Hotel cottages
places.text: Small cottage-style rooms suited to families, at the edge of the village.

places.name: Event space
places.text: Rooms for weddings, meetings and community gatherings.

places.name: Self-serve shop
places.text: A small shop open around the clock for guests' everyday needs. (concept)

districts.internalNotes: Key count unresolved: masterplan text says 65 units, stats say 115 keys. Do not publish a key count. Oct 28, 2026: '65 hotel cottages' removed from publicFacts to match this note. Possible reconciliation to confirm: 65 cottages + ~50 hotel apartments = 115 keys.
